Method and limits

The screen ranks a fixed liquid large-cap universe after the close. SPY buy-and-hold uses split/dividend-adjusted close-to-close total return with no turnover. SPY matched scales that benchmark to each model's realized volatility with 4% cash and borrowing at cash + 50bps. Each model row reports Sharpe, a 95% confidence interval, minimum detectable Sharpe, and the return difference versus matched SPY. The universe has survivorship bias, daily bars do not reconstruct exact closing-auction or opening-quote fills, and the news gate is disabled in this historical run.
